_comment: Copy to registry.local.json and put real channels in it. That file is gitignored and is
read in one place only, inside outreach.send, at send time. No address ever reaches the
model, a log line, a captured run or the UI.
Keys are the cause key's locator: a host, or host/owner/repo on a code host. '*' is the
fallback for that party kind. The values below are RFC 2606 .invalid placeholders, so a
fresh clone can exercise the whole path without writing to anybody.
